scripts.db:generate: cd packages/db && bunx prisma generate && cd ../..
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/db && bunx prisma migrate deploy && cd ../..
scripts.start:web: bun run db:migrate && cd apps/web && bun run start
scripts.start:backend: bun run db:migrate && cd apps/backend && bun run start
scripts.start:ws: bun run db:migrate && cd apps/ws && bun run start
scripts.start:all: bun run db:migrate && bun run start:web && bun run start:backend && bun run start:ws
